images.title: Big Dipper star pattern
images.alt_text: A night-sky photograph shows seven bright stars joined by faint dotted lines to outline the Big Dipper, a pattern people can use to orient themselves.
images.creator: NASA/Donald R. Pettit
images.attribution: NASA/Donald R. Pettit. NASA Space Place, “What Are Constellations?” https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/constellations/en/ .

images.title: Constellations through the year
images.alt_text: A labeled diagram places named constellations around Earth's orbit and shows how the night-sky view changes through the year.
images.creator: NASA/JPL-Caltech
images.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech. NASA Space Place, “What Are Constellations?” https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/constellations/en/ .

images.title: Our Sun compared with other stars
images.alt_text: A child-friendly size comparison labels the Sun, Betelgeuse, Pollux, Sirius, Rigel and Aldebaran; the Sun is a star, while some stars are much larger.
images.creator: NASA Space Place
images.attribution: NASA Space Place, “How Does Our Sun Compare With Other Stars?” https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/sun-compare/en/ .

images.title: The planets of our Solar System
images.alt_text: A labeled image shows Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto in rows; Pluto is shown as a dwarf planet.
images.creator: NASA/JHUAPL/Carnegie Institution of Washington; USGS Astrogeology Science Center; NASA/GSFC/STScI; NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute
images.attribution: NASA Space Place, “Gallery of NASA Solar System Images.” Individual image credits are listed on the source page: NASA/JHUAPL/Carnegie Institution of Washington, USGS Astrogeology Science Center, NASA/GSFC/STScI, and NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute. https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/gallery-solar-system/en/ .

images.title: Parts of a comet
images.alt_text: A labeled comet diagram points to the nucleus, coma, ion tail, dust tail, solar wind and sunlight.
images.creator: NASA/JPL-Caltech
images.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech. NASA Space Place, “What Is a Comet?” https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/comets/en/ .
